{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute the fraction of patients with SEVERE baseline disease
total_patients = len(df)
severe_patients = (df['severity'] == 'severe').sum()
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

# Print the fraction only, as a single number, without any extra text
print(fraction_severe)"}
